data.rationale: The proposal captures the same KOA search procedure (Filters, amenity checkbox, destination, optional dates, FIND A KOA) with all four parameters, but it fixes the step order as filter, then destination, and makes the dates look mandatory. Its steps are concrete enough to automate, though the date-picker navigation and suggestion selection are only loosely specified.
